title: A sky photo is expected to appear in Memories
preconditions: A adds a photo in Us.
B expects every shared photo to appear in Memories.
Neither has read the explanation of the two destinations.

actions.note: A chooses a photo for the sky.
B searches Memories for the same photo.

expected_behavior: The app makes clear that a sky photo and a dated memory are separate actions.
A sky photo does not silently become a dated memory.
The archive remains the complete place to browse dated content.
candidate_failure_modes: B concludes the photo failed to save.
A believes one action published to both destinations.
The app adds a second, unrequested copy to resolve the ambiguity.

observed_code_behavior: Us and Memories are intentionally separate destinations; sky photos are not dated memories.
Free and Plus see the same relationship home.
documented_requirement: The app makes clear that a sky photo and a dated memory are separate actions.
A sky photo does not silently become a dated memory.
The archive remains the complete place to browse dated content.
hypothetical_user_behavior:
A fictional participant (Grace Tan) said: "Doing this audit with VoiceOver on and text at my size, one item at a time.

The upgrade prompts: I can't tell you what they say, because the ones that reach me are unlabelled pictures that just interrupt. I abandon them. That's the cost — not money, just a small dead end I have to back out of every time.

The storage meter: I've never once got a number off it. It's a graphic, and nothing announces it. If it vanished I'd notice nothing until something quietly stopped saving.

The plan explanation copy: several screens of prose to get to the one line I actually want, about what happens to my photos. I'd rather have three plain list items than a nice paragraph.

What I would keep: the manage-subscription link. It's a real link with a real name, it's the only place I can confirm what I'm paying and stop it, and I can reach it with the rotor. Keep that, label it out loud, and remove the rest."
Grace Tan assumes: the sky is decorative and not the archive
Grace Tan assumes: photos can be found by date
Hiro Tan assumes: a pending upload is safely queued
Hiro Tan assumes: deleting a local copy does not delete the shared copy
